turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How is your Saturday starting out over in Portland?

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A warm bowl of oatmeal is perfect for a chilly Portland morning. Do you have any plans to get active or work on your hobbies today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, actually! I'm heading out to play some tennis in a little bit. It'll be good to get moving.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Have a great game! Is Grace joining you on the court today, or are you playing singles?

turns.text: Grace is sitting this one out to do some reading, so I'm just meeting up with a friend for a singles match.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice! I hope it's a good match. Do you and Grace have any plans for the evening once you're back?

turns.text: Nothing too crazy. We're thinking we'll just wind down and watch some sitcom reruns tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sitcom reruns sound like the perfect way to unwind. You definitely deserve a relaxing evening after a busy week heading up the science department.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks. Yeah, being head of the science department has kept me pretty busy lately, so a lazy Saturday night is exactly what I need.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! Speaking of relaxing, have you and Grace made any more progress planning your family trip to Japan for the spring?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A little bit! We've been looking at some hotels in Kyoto. It's exciting to think about, even if it's still a few months off. But for today, I'm just focusing on my match and those reruns.
